case: rag_llm-This sample comes from a T2D−P+ patient (no type 2 diabetes, with periodontitis). The sample is NOT from the fully unaffected control group. The control group in this study is T2D−P− (neither type 2 diabetes nor periodontitis). This sample belongs to an affected group (affected by periodontitis), so it cannot be classified as 'Study Control' per the definition requiring 'NONE of the study's conditions/exposures present.' The sample is a Case, as it has periodontitis (one of the primary conditions investigated in the study).
